title: Choose the new SEC visual world
question: The public event directory should feel unmistakably SEC while making the next event easy to spot and join.

options.label: The Gathering Hall
options.lineage: an indoor light installation and campus gathering place
options.thesis: A long, warm hall draws students toward the one event that matters next.
options.viewport: A horizon-like event beacon leads into a dense, editorial program board rather than a generic card grid.
options.risk: Needs restraint so the atmosphere never competes with dates, capacity, or registration actions.

raised.raise: Every status, date, and route uses a precise, high-contrast information hierarchy.
Event modules use varied editorial scale instead of a row of identical cards.

options.label: The Engineering Field Guide
options.lineage: a well-used campus field notebook and department wayfinding system
options.thesis: The event catalog becomes a confident, navigable guide to the semester’s opportunities.
options.viewport: A decisive title and one featured opportunity sit above a structured event index with practical route cues.
options.risk: Familiar institutional language can feel too quiet if the editorial scale is not brave enough.

options.label: Proof, Not Promises
options.thesis: Each opportunity is paired with the exact details that prove it is worth a student’s time.
options.viewport: A clean feature-and-proof split presents the next event beside capacity, time, and location facts.
options.case: It is exceptionally clear, but loses some SEC specificity to the two grounded candidates.
options.risk: Could become another polished software catalog if the institutional details are underplayed.

options.label: The Opportunity Archive
options.lineage: a collector’s archive wall and labeled storage system
options.thesis: Events stack as individual objects with a satisfying reveal.
options.viewport: Event titles become stack labels that open into fuller registration detail.
options.case: The interaction is memorable but does not serve rapid academic scheduling as clearly.
options.kept: Commitment to making each event feel distinct rather than interchangeable.
options.risk: The metaphor can overpower functional scanning.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar university event directory, executed very cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Hero copy above equal event cards and a conventional filter row.
canonCard.risk: Clear but indistinguishable from most campus event sites.
